purpose: Landmark-compatible constraint system for selecting the canonical shoulder girdle without fitting back to the r95 mesh.

clavicle_endpoint_length_mm.definition: straight 3D distance between lateral-most clavicular point in AC joint and medial-most clavicular point in SC joint

direct_AC_to_lateral_acromion_3D_mm.definition: direct anatomic distance from posterior AC joint to lateral acromion, in line with posterior clavicle/acromion; not assumed pure mediolateral

manubrium_outer_breadth_context_mm.definition: outer/max manubrial breadth associated with clavicular-notch region; not bilateral SC-centre breadth

manubrium_first_costal_width_context_mm.definition: distance between first costal-notch midpoints; not SC-centre breadth

derived_constraints.hard_width_failure: Current a003 bi-AC breadth exceeds the expected outer biacromial breadth even though each AC joint must lie medial to the lateral acromial landmark.

direct_AC_3D_constraint.invalid_relation: do not set transverse component equal to 34 mm without a mapped scapular local frame

conservative_biAC_bounds_from_outer_1sd_.note: Lower uses outer biacromial - 2*maximum 3-D distance; upper is strict outer-breadth ceiling. This is deliberately conservative, not a target.

hard_geometry_rules: each_SC_to_AC_3D_chord must be checked against endpoint-compatible adult-male clavicle evidence
AC and GH remain distinct centres
lateral acromion remains lateral to AC joint
left/right canonical geometry follows the declared symmetry/asymmetry policy

unresolved: pure transverse component of the direct 3-D lateral-acromion→AC distance after scapular frame mapping

acceptance_logic: Use the direct 2026 LA→AC result only as a 3-D distance constraint until the scapular local frame resolves its transverse component.
Reject any candidate whose bi-AC breadth equals or exceeds bilateral lateral-acromion (biacromial) breadth.
Reject any candidate whose SC-to-AC straight chord exceeds the clavicle curved centreline length.
Do not freeze absolute SC/AC coordinates until SC breadth and a direct/derived landmark-compatible AC placement constraint are available.
Do not force scapular GH-to-inferior-angle from height-only evidence.
Do not move the whole shoulder vertically just to repair width.
interpretation: The a003 shoulder-width failure remains independently confirmed by outer biacromial breadth and clavicle length.
The 2026 full text explicitly reports direct lateral-acromion→AC distance 34±8 mm (23–52 mm), correcting the earlier abstract-only source ambiguity.
That direct measurement constrains, but does not equal, the pure HGPT transverse component. Absolute SC/AC coordinates therefore remain open pending the local scapular/manubrial frame solve.
The evidence-filtered 50/60/70 mm SC sweep now has a valid direct-distance screen; it is still not a frozen target family.
next_steps: Solve SC/AC/acromion coordinates in 3D against the clavicle endpoint/centreline constraints and global shoulder-height scaffold.
Build the scapular local landmark frame independently, then place GH from the retained local depth and glenoid geometry.
Rerun shoulder-complex solver tests after the canonical girdle coordinates are instantiated.

audit_correction_2026_10_08.correction: Removed that input and all exact AC-breadth derivations depending on it.
unchanged_findings: a003 SC→AC chord grossly exceeds adult male clavicle endpoint/centreline evidence

full_text_followup.previous_state: Earlier source recheck removed an inferred 34±8 mm direct offset because it had been obtained by subtracting two STSL distances.
full_text_followup.new_full_text_fact: The paper itself explicitly reports a direct lateral-acromion→AC distance of 3.4±0.8 cm (2.3–5.2 cm).
full_text_followup.retained_semantic_guard: The direct result is a 3-D/anatomic landmark distance; it must not be treated as a pure mediolateral offset until the scapular frame is mapped.
